query:
-- Alle missingRequirements die isMissing=0 haben aber noch status='missing' auf 'provided' setzen
UPDATE missing_requirements 
SET status = 'provided', updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE isMissing = 0 AND status = 'missing';

-- Für Produkt MT4300: Safety-Felder prüfen und als provided markieren wenn Daten vorhanden
UPDATE missing_requirements mr
JOIN product_safety_entries pse ON pse.productId = mr.productId
SET mr.status = 'provided', mr.isMissing = 0, mr.updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE mr.requirementType = 'safety_text' 
  AND pse.safetyText IS NOT NULL AND pse.safetyText != ''
  AND mr.status = 'missing';

UPDATE missing_requirements mr
JOIN product_safety_entries pse ON pse.productId = mr.productId
SET mr.status = 'provided', mr.isMissing = 0, mr.updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE mr.requirementType = 'warning_text' 
  AND pse.warningText IS NOT NULL AND pse.warningText != ''
  AND mr.status = 'missing';

UPDATE missing_requirements mr
JOIN product_safety_entries pse ON pse.productId = mr.productId
SET mr.status = 'provided', mr.isMissing = 0, mr.updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE mr.requirementType = 'age_grading' 
  AND pse.ageGrading IS NOT NULL AND pse.ageGrading != ''
  AND mr.status = 'missing';
